preConditions.onFailMessage: AUR-19: найдены ФМ, привязанные к нескольким кассам. Запустите db/check_fiscal_module_duplicates.sql, отвяжите дубли и повторите деплой.
preConditions.sqlCheck: WITH bindings AS ( SELECT 'CASH_REGISTER_FISCAL_CARD' AS fm_group, cr.id AS register_id, LOWER(TRIM(cr.fiscal_card_id)) AS fm_key FROM cash_registers cr WHERE cr.fiscal_card_id IS NOT NULL AND TRIM(cr.fiscal_card_id) <> '' UNION ALL SELECT 'MULTIKASSA_FM_SERIAL', mk.cash_register_id, LOWER(TRIM(mk.terminal_id)) FROM cash_register_multikassa_settings mk WHERE mk.terminal_id IS NOT NULL AND TRIM(mk.terminal_id) <> '' UNION ALL SELECT 'MULTIKASSA_FM_SERIAL', mk.cash_register_id, LOWER(TRIM(mk.module_number)) FROM cash_register_multikassa_settings mk WHERE mk.module_number IS NOT NULL AND TRIM(mk.module_number) <> '' UNION ALL SELECT 'MULTIKASSA_DRIVE', mk.cash_register_id, LOWER(TRIM(mk.selected_drive_id)) FROM cash_register_multikassa_settings mk WHERE mk.selected_drive_id IS NOT NULL AND TRIM(mk.selected_drive_id) <> '' UNION ALL SELECT 'FISCAL_DRIVE_FACTORY', fd.cash_register_id, LOWER(TRIM(fd.factory_id)) FROM cash_register_fiscal_drive_settings fd WHERE fd.factory_id IS NOT NULL AND TRIM(fd.factory_id) <> '' UNION ALL SELECT 'FISCAL_DRIVE_TERMINAL', fd.cash_register_id, LOWER(TRIM(fd.terminal_id)) FROM cash_register_fiscal_drive_settings fd WHERE fd.terminal_id IS NOT NULL AND TRIM(fd.terminal_id) <> '' ) SELECT COUNT(*) FROM ( SELECT fm_group, fm_key FROM bindings GROUP BY fm_group, fm_key HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT register_id) > 1 ) conflicts
